text:
Sara (Sales): Handing off Nebula Therapeutics (12mo Dedicated). PoC succeeded; exec sponsor signed. Passing to CS for onboarding + compliance run.

Sara (Sales): Quick asks: Okta SAML+SCIM, private model mount for PHI evals, VPC peering (preferred window 01:00-04:00 UTC), capacity for 4 rps steady with 10 rps spikes.

Priya (CS): I'll lead onboarding. Owners: Priya (onboarding lead), Jae (runbooks & tickets), Ravi (peering/infra), Lena (support/playbook), Devin (smoke tests).

Priya (CS): Pre-kickoff checklist from CS: SSO metadata, customer ASN, CIDR allowlist, expected hourly QPS curve, and confirmation DPA/BAA signed.

Sara (Sales): Procurement confirmed DPA. Contact is infra@nebulather.org (M. Ortega). ASN pending; I'll fetch today.

Ravi (Infra): Need ASN + CIDRs to configure routes. HSM ETA for Dedicated tenants ~6 weeks; KMS with CMK available now. Will prepare a short compliance note for procurement.

Devin (Solutions): I'll prepare a 10-prompt smoke set and a tiny python harness and upload to /shared/nebula-tests. Example curl for quick smoke post-SSO:
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-ded","input":"Ping"}'

Jae (CS Ops): I'll create ticket NB-501 and add checklist: SSO verify, SCIM provisioning, peering validate, model mount verify, smoke tests, canary cutover.

ticket-bot: Ticket NB-501 created by Jae (CS Ops) - https://support.redwood.ai/NB-501

Lena (Support): I'll draft 30-day oncall plan and alert thresholds. Proposal: page on error-rate>1.5% or p95>350ms for first 14 days.

Priya (CS): Success metrics: go-live <=30d, p95 <300ms steady, SSO+SCIM functional, smoke pass, zero Sev1 first 14 days. Kickoff Thurs 14:30 UTC; will send invite and agenda.

Sara (Sales): Also noted: customer requested a provisional credit if SLA missed in first 60d. Legal ok'd conditional language. Flag in risk register.

Ravi (Infra): I'll run staging capacity tests tomorrow and post numbers to NB-501. Preliminary expectation: ~220-260ms p95 @512 tokens on a40-class with continuous batching.

Devin (Solutions): Uploaded initial smoke CSV to /shared/nebula-tests. Will attach harness and expected thresholds after staging run.

Jae (CS Ops): Action items (owners):
- Priya: schedule kickoff + risk register owner
- Ravi: validate VPC peering + post HSM/KMS note
- Devin: upload smoke tests & harness
- Lena: create runbook + oncall rota
- Jae: populate NB-501 and track progress

Priya (CS): Good handoff. Owners please update NB-501 as you make progress and add pre-kick docs to /shared/nebula by Wed EOD.
